claims: Braylon Mullins is a freshman guard for the UConn Huskies in the 2025-26 season.
Braylon Mullins is the son of Josh Mullins and Katie Mullins.
Josh Mullins played college basketball at Lincoln Trail College.
Josh Mullins played college basketball at Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis (IUPUI).
Braylon Mullins credits Josh Mullins for teaching him to be persistent, fighting through challenges, and pushing him to his maximum potential in basketball, according to Instagram posts.
Braylon Mullins is not related to NBA Hall of Famer Chris Mullin.
